result:
This confirms scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts and scripts/build-manifest.ts are just documentation metadata (string literals describing which functions each app file "must use"), not actual calls to `assertOrgScope`. I'll exclude those, along with `src/types/member.ts` (comment-only mention).

Every service file, action, route, layout, and lib file that has a genuine `assertOrgScope(...)` invocation is included, including `src/lib/tenant.ts` itself (which calls it internally from `assertRowsInScope`) and the test file that exercises it directly.

**ANSWER: src/lib/tenant.ts, src/lib/actor.ts, src/actions/organizations/switch-org.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/_lib/tenant-context.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx, src/app/api/issues/[issueId]/route.ts, src/app/api/orgs/[orgId]/usage/route.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/session-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, tests/lib/tenant.test.ts**
